verdict.rationale: Antigravity's first-party docs say Projects can span multiple folders, such as a frontend and a backend repo, giving agents the context of the whole codebase. Agents work within these multi-folder Projects as their access boundary, and conversations are grouped into them. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-folder Projects, and detail on how context is indexed across folders.

support.subject: As a developer, I can include multiple project directories in a single session for broader context

citations.quote: a project can work with one folder or multiple folders (e.g., a frontend and a backend repo), providing your agents with all of the context required for your codebase
Group your conversations into Projects, which can span multiple folders and support custom settings and scoped permissions.
Agents work within Projects, which define the boundaries of the folders and repositories they can access.
